en.B: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.
en.R: Some of the elders of Israel came and sat down with me.

pt.B: Alguns dos anciãos de Israel vieram até mim e se sentaram na minha frente.
pt.R: Alguns dos anciãos de Israel vieram e se sentaram comigo.

fr.B: Quelques-uns des anciens d’Israël vinrent me trouver et s’assirent devant moi.

ko.B: 이스라엘의 장로 몇 사람이 나에게 와서 내 앞에 앉았다.

vi.B: Một vài trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên đến gặp tôi và ngồi xuống trước mặt tôi.

source.text: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָאֵ֨לֶּה֙ הֶעֱל֤וּ גִלּֽוּלֵיהֶם֙ עַל־לִבָּ֔ם וּמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עֲוֺנָ֔ם נָתְנ֖וּ נֹ֣כַח פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם הַאִדָּרֹ֥שׁ אִדָּרֵ֖שׁ לָהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Son of man, the men these have brought up their idols upon their heart, and [the] stumbling block of their iniquity they have put before their faces; [should I] really let myself be inquired of by them?

en.L: Son of man, these men have brought up their filthy idols into their heart, and the stumbling block of their iniquity they have set before their faces. Should I really let myself be consulted by them?
en.B: Son of man, these men have taken idols into their hearts and placed before their faces the stumbling block that leads them into guilt. Should I let them consult {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} at all?
en.R: Son of man, these men have made idols the center of their lives. They have put right in front of themselves the very thing that makes them fall into sin. Why should I let them ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for anything?

pt.L: Filho do homem, estes homens fizeram subir os seus ídolos imundos ao seu coração, e o tropeço da sua iniquidade puseram diante do seu rosto. Deveria eu de fato deixar-me consultar por eles?
pt.B: Filho do homem, estes homens levaram ídolos para dentro do coração e puseram diante do rosto o tropeço que os leva à culpa. Devo deixar que eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consultem?
pt.R: Filho do homem, estes homens fizeram dos ídolos o centro da sua vida. Puseram bem na frente de si mesmos aquilo que os faz cair no pecado. Por que eu deixaria que eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pedissem alguma coisa?

fr.L: Fils d’homme, ces hommes ont fait monter leurs idoles immondes dans leur cœur, et ils ont placé devant leur face la pierre d’achoppement de leur iniquité. Me laisserai-je vraiment consulter par eux ?
fr.B: Fils d’homme, ces hommes ont installé des idoles dans leur cœur et ont placé devant eux l’obstacle qui les fait tomber dans la faute. Les laisserai-je seulement {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consulter ?
fr.R: Fils d’homme, ces hommes ont mis les idoles au centre de leur vie. Ils ont placé juste devant eux ce qui les fait tomber dans le péché. Pourquoi les laisserais-je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} demander quoi que ce soit ?

ko.L: 사람의 아들아, 이 사람들이 자기들의 더러운 우상들을 마음에 들여놓고, 자기들의 죄악의 걸림돌을 자기들 얼굴 앞에 두었다. 그러니 내가 정말 그들에게 [내 뜻을] 묻게 하겠느냐?
ko.B: 사람의 아들아, 이 사람들은 우상들을 마음에 품고, 자기들을 죄에 빠뜨리는 걸림돌을 얼굴 앞에 두었다. 그런데 내가 그들에게 나에게 묻는 것을 허락하겠느냐?
ko.R: 사람의 아들아, 이 사람들은 우상을 삶의 중심으로 삼았다. 자기들을 죄에 빠지게 하는 것을 바로 자기 눈앞에 두었다. 그런데 내가 왜 그들의 물음에 대답해 주어야 하느냐?

sw.L: Mwana wa binadamu, watu hawa wamezipandisha sanamu zao chafu mioyoni mwao, na kikwazo cha uovu wao wamekiweka mbele ya nyuso zao. Je, kweli nitakubali kuulizwa nao?
sw.B: Mwana wa binadamu, watu hawa wamezipokea sanamu mioyoni mwao na kuweka mbele ya nyuso zao kikwazo kinachowaangusha katika hatia. Je, niwaache waniulize hata kidogo?
sw.R: Mwana wa binadamu, watu hawa wamezifanya sanamu kuwa kitu muhimu kuliko vyote maishani mwao. Wameweka mbele yao kitu kile kile kinachowaangusha katika dhambi. Kwa nini niwaache waniulize chochote?

es.L: Hijo de hombre, estos hombres han hecho subir sus ídolos inmundos a su corazón, y han puesto delante de su rostro el tropiezo de su iniquidad. ¿Acaso me dejaré consultar por ellos?
es.B: Hijo de hombre, estos hombres han metido ídolos en su corazón y han puesto delante de su rostro el tropiezo que los lleva a la culpa. ¿Acaso voy a dejar que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consulten?
es.R: Hijo de hombre, estos hombres han hecho de los ídolos el centro de su vida. Han puesto justo delante de ellos lo mismo que los hace caer en pecado. ¿Por qué habría de dejar que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pidan algo?

vi.L: Hỡi con người, những người này đã đem các thần tượng nhơ bẩn của chúng lên trong lòng mình, và đã đặt vật gây vấp ngã của tội ác chúng trước mặt mình. Lẽ nào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lại để cho chúng cầu hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao?
vi.B: Hỡi con người, những người này đã rước thần tượng vào lòng, và đặt trước mặt mình vật gây vấp ngã dẫn chúng vào tội lỗi. Lẽ nào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lại để cho chúng cầu hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?
vi.R: Hỡi con người, những người này đã đặt thần tượng làm trung tâm đời sống mình. Chúng đặt ngay trước mặt mình chính thứ làm cho chúng sa vào tội lỗi. Tại sao {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phải để chúng hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} điều gì chứ?

decisions.choice: brought up their idols into their heart: they are devoted to idols in mind and will
decisions.reason: The idols may not be in their houses, but they are in their hearts. The heart is the center of thought and loyalty; these men come to the LORD's prophet while their loyalty lies elsewhere.

decisions.choice: the stumbling block of their iniquity: the idols, which make them fall into guilt
decisions.reason: The phrase is used in 7:19; 18:30 and 44:12. A stumbling block is something that trips a person up; they have set it right in their own path.

decisions.choice: "Should I really let myself be consulted?": the doubled verb expects the answer no
decisions.reason: The question repeats the verb for emphasis. The LORD will answer, but not in the way they want (14:4, 7-8).

decisions.choice: filthy idols (L), idols (B, R); iniquity (L), guilt (B), sin (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these words in Ezekiel and the prophets.

decisions.choice: o tropeço da sua iniquidade (L); o tropeço que os leva à culpa (B); aquilo que os faz cair no pecado (R)
decisions.reason: "Tropeço" is the thing that makes someone stumble; iniquity is "iniquidade" (L), "culpa" (B), "pecado" (R), as Isaiah and Jeremiah set it.

decisions.choice: deixar-me consultar
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the reflexive with an enclisis after the infinitive, which careful written Portuguese allows; "Deveria eu" keeps the question's stress on the LORD.

decisions.choice: ’idoles immondes’ (L); ’idoles’ (B, R) for gillulim, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The book’s term list, following the English levels: Literal keeps the contempt in Ezekiel’s word, Balanced and Readable say ’idoles’.

decisions.choice: ’iniquité’ (L); ’faute’ (B); ’péché’ (R) for avon
decisions.reason: Following the English ’iniquity’, ’guilt’, ’sin’; French ’faute’ carries both the wrong and the guilt for it.

decisions.choice: "더러운 우상들" (L), "우상들" (B, R) for gillulim, through these chapters
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording (see 6:4).

decisions.choice: "죄악의 걸림돌" (L), "죄에 빠뜨리는 걸림돌" (B), "죄에 빠지게 하는 것" (R)
decisions.reason: 걸림돌 is the word of the published Jeremiah 6:21; B and R spell out what the stumbling block does, as the shared decision explains it.

decisions.choice: "sanamu chafu" (L), "sanamu" (B, R); "uovu" (L), "hatia" (B), "dhambi" (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's word gillulim is "sanamu chafu" (filthy idols) at Literal and plain "sanamu" at Balanced and Readable, as the English; used the same way through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "ídolos inmundos" (L), "ídolos" (B, R); "iniquidad" (L), "culpa" (B), "pecado" (R)
decisions.reason: Gillulim as the terms note sets it for Ezekiel (2 Kings 17:12), kept apart from shiqqutsim; 'awon at each level as the English reads it.

decisions.choice: gillulim: "thần tượng nhơ bẩn" (L); "thần tượng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms, as Leviticus 26:30 and 2 Kings 17:12; Literal keeps the English Literal's "filthy". Used unchanged through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "vật gây vấp ngã của tội ác" (L); "vật gây vấp ngã dẫn vào tội lỗi" (B); "thứ làm cho ... sa vào tội lỗi" (R)
decisions.reason: 'Avon is "tội ác" (L) / "tội lỗi" (B) / "tội" (R) in these chapters; the stumbling block is named as what makes them fall into guilt, as the meaning decision explains.

source.text: לָכֵ֣ן דַּבֵּר־א֠וֹתָם וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר׀אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲלֶ֨ה אֶת־גִּלּוּלָ֜יו אֶל־לִבּ֗וֹ וּמִכְשׁ֤וֹל עֲוֺנוֹ֙ יָשִׂים֙ נֹ֣כַח פָּנָ֔יו וּבָ֖א אֶל־הַנָּבִ֑יא אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה נַעֲנֵ֧יתִי ל֦וֹ בָ֖א בְּרֹ֥ב גִּלּוּלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore speak to them and say to them, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Any man of [the] house of Israel who brings up his idols upon his heart, and [the] stumbling block of his iniquity puts before his face, and comes to the prophet, I Yahweh will let myself be brought to answer him in it, according to [the] multitude of his idols,

en.L: Therefore speak to them and say to them, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: {{gender:Anyone|Any man}} of the house of Israel who brings up {{gender:their|his}} filthy idols into {{gender:their|his}} heart and sets the stumbling block of {{gender:their|his}} iniquity before {{gender:their|his}} face, and comes to the prophet, I {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will answer {{gender:them|him}} {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}, according to the multitude of {{gender:their|his}} filthy idols,
en.B: Therefore speak to them and tell them: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: When {{gender:anyone|any man}} of the house of Israel sets up idols in {{gender:their|his}} heart, puts the stumbling block of {{gender:their|his}} guilt before {{gender:their|his}} face, and then goes to the prophet, I {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will give {{gender:that person|him}} an answer, as the great number of {{gender:their|his}} idols deserves,
en.R: So speak to them. Tell them this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: Suppose people from Israel make idols the center of their lives and put right in front of themselves what makes them fall into sin. Then they come to a prophet. I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, will give them an answer {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}, the answer their many idols deserve.

pt.L: Por isso, fala com eles e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: {{gender:Qualquer pessoa|Qualquer homem}} da casa de Israel que fizer subir os seus ídolos imundos ao seu coração e puser o tropeço da sua iniquidade diante do seu rosto, e vier ao profeta, eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, eu mesmo lhe responderei, segundo a multidão dos seus ídolos imundos,
pt.B: Por isso, fala com eles e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Quando {{gender:alguém|algum homem}} da casa de Israel instalar ídolos no coração, puser diante do rosto o tropeço da sua culpa e depois for ao profeta, eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, lhe darei eu mesmo uma resposta, como merece a grande quantidade dos seus ídolos,
pt.R: Por isso, fala com eles. Dize-lhes que é isto que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} diz: Imaginem que algumas pessoas de Israel façam dos ídolos o centro da sua vida e ponham bem na frente de si mesmas aquilo que as faz cair no pecado. Depois elas vão a um profeta. Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, vou dar a elas a resposta eu mesmo, a resposta que os seus muitos ídolos merecem.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi parle-leur et dis-leur : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : {{gender:Toute personne|Tout homme}} de la maison d’Israël qui fait monter ses idoles immondes dans son cœur, qui place devant sa face la pierre d’achoppement de son iniquité, et qui vient vers le prophète, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je lui répondrai {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, selon la multitude de ses idoles immondes,
fr.B: C’est pourquoi parle-leur et dis-leur : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Quand quelqu’un de la maison d’Israël installe des idoles dans son cœur, place devant lui l’obstacle qui le fait tomber dans la faute, puis va trouver le prophète, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je lui répondrai {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, comme le mérite la multitude de ses idoles,
fr.R: Alors parle-leur. Dis-leur : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Supposons que des gens d’Israël mettent les idoles au centre de leur vie et placent juste devant eux ce qui les fait tomber dans le péché. Puis ils vont trouver un prophète. Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je leur répondrai {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, de la manière que méritent leurs nombreuses idoles.

ko.L: 그러므로 그들에게 일러 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 이스라엘 집의 누구든지 자기의 더러운 우상들을 마음에 들여놓고 자기 죄악의 걸림돌을 자기 얼굴 앞에 두고서 예언자에게 오면, 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그의 많은 더러운 우상들에 따라 친히 그에게 대답하겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 그들에게 일러 주어라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 이스라엘 집의 누구든지 마음에 우상들을 세우고 자기를 죄에 빠뜨리는 걸림돌을 얼굴 앞에 두고서 예언자에게 오면, 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 친히 그의 많은 우상들에 걸맞은 대답을 그에게 주겠다.
ko.R: 그러므로 그들에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 이스라엘 사람 가운데 누가 우상을 삶의 중심으로 삼고, 자기를 죄에 빠지게 하는 것을 바로 자기 눈앞에 두었다고 하자. 그러고서 그 사람이 예언자에게 온다면, 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그에게 직접 대답하겠다. 그의 많은 우상들이 받아야 할 대답을 주겠다.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo sema nao na uwaambie, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kila mtu wa nyumba ya Israeli anayezipandisha sanamu zake chafu moyoni mwake na kuweka kikwazo cha uovu wake mbele ya uso wake, kisha akamwendea nabii, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitamjibu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, kwa kadiri ya wingi wa sanamu zake chafu,
sw.B: Kwa hiyo sema nao uwaambie: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Mtu yeyote wa nyumba ya Israeli akiweka sanamu moyoni mwake, akaweka kikwazo cha hatia yake mbele ya uso wake, kisha akamwendea nabii, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitampa jibu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, kama wingi wa sanamu zake unavyostahili,
sw.R: Kwa hiyo sema nao. Waambie kwamba hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Tuseme watu wa Israeli wanazifanya sanamu kuwa kitu muhimu kuliko vyote maishani mwao, na kuweka mbele yao kitu kinachowaangusha katika dhambi. Kisha wanamwendea nabii. Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitawapa jibu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, jibu ambalo sanamu zao nyingi zinastahili.

es.L: Por tanto, háblales y diles: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: {{gender:Cualquier persona|Cualquier hombre}} de la casa de Israel que haga subir sus ídolos inmundos a su corazón y ponga el tropiezo de su iniquidad delante de su rostro, y venga al profeta, yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, le responderé por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} mismo, conforme a la multitud de sus ídolos inmundos,
es.B: Por tanto, háblales y diles: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Cuando {{gender:alguien|algún hombre}} de la casa de Israel instale ídolos en su corazón, ponga delante de su rostro el tropiezo de su culpa y luego acuda al profeta, yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, le daré personalmente la respuesta que merece la gran cantidad de sus ídolos,
es.R: Así que háblales. Diles que esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Supongamos que alguna gente de Israel hace de los ídolos el centro de su vida y pone justo delante de sí lo que la hace caer en pecado. Luego acude a un profeta. Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, le daré personalmente la respuesta, la respuesta que merecen sus muchos ídolos.

vi.L: Vì vậy, hãy nói với chúng và bảo chúng: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Bất cứ ai trong nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên đem các thần tượng nhơ bẩn của mình lên trong lòng, đặt vật gây vấp ngã của tội ác mình trước mặt mình, rồi đến với nhà tiên tri, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sẽ đích thân trả lời người ấy, theo số nhiều thần tượng nhơ bẩn của người ấy,
vi.B: Vì thế, hãy nói với chúng và bảo chúng: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Khi bất cứ ai trong nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên lập thần tượng trong lòng, đặt vật gây vấp ngã dẫn vào tội lỗi trước mặt mình, rồi lại đến với nhà tiên tri, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sẽ đích thân trả lời người ấy, đúng như số thần tượng đông đảo của người ấy đáng phải nhận,
vi.R: Vậy hãy nói với chúng. Hãy bảo chúng rằng đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Giả sử có những người Y-sơ-ra-ên đặt thần tượng làm trung tâm đời sống mình, và đặt ngay trước mặt mình thứ làm cho mình sa vào tội lỗi. Rồi họ đến với một nhà tiên tri. Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sẽ trả lời họ, theo cách mà vô số thần tượng của họ đáng phải nhận.

decisions.choice: I will answer him myself according to the multitude of his idols: the text as read
alternatives: "I will answer him by it", following the written consonants
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has "by it"; the scribes' marginal reading has "he comes", giving "I will answer him as he comes with the multitude of his idols". The sense of both is that the LORD will answer such a person directly, and as his idols deserve, not with the oracle he wants.

decisions.choice: I the LORD will answer him myself: the answer is judgment, not an oracle
decisions.reason: The LORD will not give a word through the prophet to someone who clings to idols. He will answer in person, by acting against him (14:8).

decisions.choice: {{gender:anyone|any man}}; {{gender:their|his}}; {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: "Any man" here means any person, as in the laws of Leviticus 17:3 and 20:2, which have the same form; the pronouns follow. Readable uses the plural "people", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: {{gender:Qualquer pessoa|Qualquer homem}} (L); {{gender:alguém|algum homem}} (B)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): "any man" means any person, so the noun takes the gender setting. Portuguese needs it only on the noun: "seu", "sua" and "lhe" do not mark gender, so the English spans on "their/his" have no counterpart.

decisions.choice: eu mesmo, with no setting
decisions.reason: The English "myself" takes a span. Portuguese stresses the LORD's own action with "eu mesmo", and "eu" for God takes no span (style §7), as at 13:7; so this and 14:7 (B, R) have none.

decisions.choice: "누구든지", "자기" and "그" with no gender span, where the English has {{gender:anyone|any man}} and the like
decisions.reason: Korean 누구든지 and 자기 cover men and women alike, so there is only one wording; the case law of chapters 14 and 18 has no spans in Korean.

decisions.choice: "나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가" with no -시-, and "친히" / "직접" for "myself"
decisions.reason: God names himself without the honorific, as the Isaiah-Jeremiah note settled; 친히 carries the stress the English gives with "myself".

decisions.choice: "{{gender:Cualquier persona|Cualquier hombre}}" (L); "{{gender:alguien|algún hombre}}" (B)
decisions.reason: The case law speaks of anyone; the span sits on the noun, and "su" and "le" already cover both. In 14:8 the object pronouns follow the noun ("{{gender:la|lo}}").

decisions.choice: "bất cứ ai", "người ấy", "mình", with no gender spans
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "ai", "người ấy" and "mình" already include men and women, so the English gender spans in this case law (14:4-8) have no Vietnamese counterpart.

decisions.choice: L ’Toute personne’ (alternative ’Tout homme’); B ’quelqu’un’ with no span
decisions.reason: Literal puts the setting on the noun, as the English does; the pronouns that follow need none in French (’ses’, ’son’, ’lui’). Balanced says ’quelqu’un’, which is already generic, so no span (see 13:22).

source.text: לְמַ֛עַן תְּפֹ֥שׂ אֶת־בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּלִבָּ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָזֹ֨רוּ֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י בְּגִלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֖ם כֻּלָּֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: in order to seize [the] house of Israel by their heart, who are estranged from me through their idols, all of them.

en.L: in order to take hold of the house of Israel by their heart, since they have all become estranged from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} through their filthy idols.
en.B: so that I may lay hold of the hearts of the house of Israel, who have all turned away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to their idols.
en.R: I will do this to take hold of the hearts of the people of Israel. All of them have turned away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to their idols.

pt.L: para tomar a casa de Israel pelo seu coração, porque todos eles se afastaram de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} por causa dos seus ídolos imundos.
pt.B: para que eu possa agarrar o coração da casa de Israel, que se afastou toda de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} para seguir os seus ídolos.
pt.R: Vou fazer isso para tomar conta do coração do povo de Israel. Todos eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deixaram e foram atrás dos seus ídolos.

fr.L: afin de saisir la maison d’Israël par leur cœur, car ils se sont tous éloignés de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} par leurs idoles immondes.
fr.B: afin que je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}empare du cœur de la maison d’Israël, qui s’est tout entière détournée de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} pour suivre ses idoles.
fr.R: Je ferai cela pour reprendre le cœur du peuple d’Israël. Tous se sont détournés de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} pour suivre leurs idoles.

ko.L: 그것은 더러운 우상들 때문에 모두 나에게서 멀어진 이스라엘 집의 마음을 내가 붙잡으려는 것이다.
ko.B: 이것은 모두 우상들을 따라가 나를 멀리한 이스라엘 집의 마음을 내가 사로잡으려는 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 이렇게 하는 것은 이스라엘 백성의 마음을 붙잡으려는 것이다. 그들은 모두 나를 떠나 우상들에게로 갔다.

sw.L: ili niishike nyumba ya Israeli kwa moyo wao, kwa kuwa wote wamejitenga {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} kwa sanamu zao chafu.
sw.B: ili niishike mioyo ya nyumba ya Israeli, ambao wote wamegeuka kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} na kuzifuata sanamu zao.
sw.R: Nitafanya hivi ili niishike mioyo ya watu wa Israeli. Wote wameniacha na kuzifuata sanamu zao.

es.L: para tomar a la casa de Israel por su corazón, ya que todos ellos se han apartado de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} por sus ídolos inmundos.
es.B: para apoderarme del corazón de la casa de Israel, que toda entera se ha alejado de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} para seguir a sus ídolos.
es.R: Haré esto para ganarme de nuevo el corazón del pueblo de Israel. Todos se han alejado de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} para seguir a sus ídolos.

vi.L: để nắm lấy nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên nơi lòng của chúng, vì tất cả chúng đều đã xa cách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bởi các thần tượng nhơ bẩn của mình.
vi.B: để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nắm lấy lòng nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những kẻ đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để theo thần tượng của mình.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm vậy để nắm lấy lòng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Tất cả chúng đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà theo các thần tượng của mình.

decisions.choice: take hold of the house of Israel by their heart: to grip their hearts and bring them back
alternatives: to catch them out by what is in their hearts
decisions.reason: The verb means to seize or grasp. The LORD's direct answer is meant to lay hold of the people's hearts, which have gone over to idols, and turn them back (14:6). It may also mean that the LORD will expose them by what is in their hearts.

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר׀אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה שׁ֣וּבוּ וְהָשִׁ֔יבוּ מֵעַ֖ל גִּלּֽוּלֵיכֶ֑ם וּמֵעַ֥ל כָּל־תּוֹעֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם הָשִׁ֥יבוּ פְנֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore say to [the] house of Israel, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Turn back, and turn away from your idols, and from all your abominations turn away your faces.

en.L: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Turn back, and turn [yourselves] away from your filthy idols, and from all your abominations turn away your faces.
en.B: Therefore say to the house of Israel: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Repent! Turn away from your idols, and turn your faces away from all your detestable practices.
en.R: So tell the people of Israel that this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: Come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}! Turn away from your idols. Stop doing all those disgusting things.

pt.L: Por isso, dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Voltem, e afastem-se dos seus ídolos imundos, e de todas as suas abominações desviem o rosto.
pt.B: Por isso, dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Arrependam-se! Afastem-se dos seus ídolos e desviem o rosto de todas as suas práticas detestáveis.
pt.R: Por isso, dize ao povo de Israel que é isto que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} diz: Voltem para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}! Abandonem os seus ídolos. Parem de fazer todas essas coisas repugnantas.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi dis à la maison d’Israël : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Revenez, et détournez-vous de vos idoles immondes, et de toutes vos abominations détournez vos faces.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi dis à la maison d’Israël : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Revenez ! Détournez-vous de vos idoles, et détournez vos visages de toutes vos pratiques détestables.
fr.R: Alors dis au peuple d’Israël : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ! Détournez-vous de vos idoles. Arrêtez de faire toutes ces choses dégoûtantes.

ko.L: 그러므로 이스라엘 집에 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 돌아오너라. 너희의 더러운 우상들에게서 돌아서고, 너희의 모든 가증한 일에서 너희 얼굴을 돌려라.
ko.B: 그러므로 이스라엘 집에 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 돌아오너라! 너희 우상들에게서 돌아서고, 너희의 모든 역겨운 짓에서 얼굴을 돌려라.
ko.R: 그러니 이스라엘 백성에게 전하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 마음을 돌이켜 나에게 돌아오너라! 너희 우상들을 버려라. 그 모든 역겨운 일을 그만두어라.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo iambie nyumba ya Israeli, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Rudini, mjigeuze mziache sanamu zenu chafu, na kutoka kwa machukizo yenu yote geuzeni nyuso zenu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo iambie nyumba ya Israeli: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Rudini! Ziacheni sanamu zenu, na geuzeni nyuso zenu mbali na matendo yenu yote ya kuchukiza.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo waambie watu wa Israeli kwamba hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Nirudieni! Ziacheni sanamu zenu. Acheni mambo yote ya kinyaa mnayoyatenda.

es.L: Por tanto, di a la casa de Israel: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}}, y {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de {{plural_you:sus ídolos inmundos|vuestros ídolos inmundos}}, y de todas {{plural_you:sus abominaciones|vuestras abominaciones}} {{plural_you:aparten sus rostros|apartad vuestros rostros}}.
es.B: Por tanto, di a la casa de Israel: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: ¡{{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}}! {{plural_you:Apártense de sus ídolos|Apartaos de vuestros ídolos}}, y {{plural_you:aparten su rostro de todas sus prácticas detestables|apartad vuestro rostro de todas vuestras prácticas detestables}}.
es.R: Por eso, dile al pueblo de Israel que esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: ¡{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}! {{plural_you:Apártense de sus ídolos|Apartaos de vuestros ídolos}}. {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de hacer todas esas cosas repugnantes.

vi.L: Vì vậy hãy nói với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Hãy quay về, hãy quay [mình] khỏi các thần tượng nhơ bẩn của các ngươi, và hãy quay mặt các ngươi khỏi mọi điều ghê tởm của các ngươi.
vi.B: Vì thế, hãy nói với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Hãy ăn năn quay về! Hãy từ bỏ thần tượng của các ngươi, và quay mặt khỏi mọi việc làm ghê tởm của các ngươi.
vi.R: Vậy hãy nói với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên rằng đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Hãy quay về cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! Hãy từ bỏ các thần tượng của các ngươi. Hãy thôi làm mọi việc ghê tởm ấy.

decisions.choice: turn back: repent, change direction
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn or return. Here it is the call to repentance that runs through Ezekiel (18:30-32; 33:11): to turn from idols back to the LORD.

decisions.choice: Come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}
decisions.reason: Readable says to whom the people are to turn back, as the context implies.

decisions.choice: ’Revenez’ at every level for shuv (R ’Revenez à moi’)
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah, French keeps ’revenir’ for shuv at every level, so the call to repent and the return are one word.

decisions.choice: "돌아오너라" for shuv (turn back), with R adding "마음을 돌이켜 나에게"
decisions.reason: The Isaiah-Jeremiah note keeps 돌아오다 for shuv at every level and leaves 회개하다 for the Greek of the New Testament; R makes the return to God explicit, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: "Rudini" (L, B); "Nirudieni" (R)
decisions.reason: Shuv (turn back, repent) is "kurudi" at every level, as in the Swahili Jeremiah, so the call to repent keeps the picture of turning round; Readable adds "to me" as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "{{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}}" (L, B); "{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a mí" (R)
decisions.reason: Shuv of repentance is "volver" or "volverse", never "arrepentirse", as the Jeremiah terms note sets it for Spanish.

decisions.choice: "Hãy quay về" (L); "Hãy ăn năn quay về" (B); "Hãy quay về cùng Ta" (R)
decisions.reason: Shuv as repentance follows the Jeremiah wording ("quay về"); Balanced adds "ăn năn" for the English "Repent". The two other verbs of turning keep the Hebrew's repetition with "quay".

source.text: כִּי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמֵהַגֵּר֮ אֲשֶׁר־יָג֣וּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְיִנָּזֵ֣ר מֵֽאַחֲרַ֗י וְיַ֤עַל גִּלּוּלָיו֙ אֶל־לִבּ֔וֹ וּמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עֲוֺנ֔וֹ יָשִׂ֖ים נֹ֣כַח פָּנָ֑יו וּבָ֤א אֶל־הַנָּבִיא֙ לִדְרָשׁ־ל֣וֹ בִ֔י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה נַֽעֲנֶה־לּ֖וֹ בִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For any man of [the] house of Israel, or of the sojourner who sojourns in Israel, who separates himself from after me, and brings up his idols upon his heart, and [the] stumbling block of his iniquity puts before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire of him concerning me, I Yahweh will let myself be brought to answer him by myself.

en.L: For {{gender:anyone|any man}} of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners who sojourn in Israel, who separates {{gender:themselves|himself}} from following {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and brings up {{gender:their|his}} filthy idols into {{gender:their|his}} heart and sets the stumbling block of {{gender:their|his}} iniquity before {{gender:their|his}} face, and comes to the prophet to inquire of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} through him, I {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will answer {{gender:them|him}} by {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}.
en.B: For if {{gender:anyone|any man}} of the house of Israel, or of the outsiders who live in Israel, separates {{gender:themselves|himself}} from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, sets up idols in {{gender:their|his}} heart, puts the stumbling block of {{gender:their|his}} guilt before {{gender:their|his}} face, and then comes to a prophet to inquire of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} through him, I {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will answer {{gender:that person|him}} {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}.
en.R: Suppose someone from Israel, or a stranger living in Israel, turns away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They make idols the center of their lives and put right in front of themselves what makes them fall into sin. Then they come to a prophet to ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for advice. I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, will answer them {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}.

pt.L: Pois {{gender:qualquer pessoa|qualquer homem}} da casa de Israel, ou dos imigrantes que moram em Israel, que se separar de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e fizer subir os seus ídolos imundos ao seu coração e puser o tropeço da sua iniquidade diante do seu rosto, e vier ao profeta para {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consultar por meio dele, eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, lhe responderei por {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} mesmo.
pt.B: Pois, se {{gender:alguém|algum homem}} da casa de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros que moram em Israel, se separar de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, instalar ídolos no coração, puser diante do rosto o tropeço da sua culpa e depois for a um profeta para {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consultar por meio dele, eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, lhe responderei eu mesmo.
pt.R: Imaginem que alguém de Israel, ou um estrangeiro que mora em Israel, se afaste de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Essa pessoa faz dos ídolos o centro da sua vida e põe bem na sua frente aquilo que a faz cair no pecado. Depois vai a um profeta para {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pedir um conselho. Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, vou responder a ela eu mesmo.

fr.L: Car {{gender:toute personne|tout homme}} de la maison d’Israël, ou des immigrés qui séjournent en Israël, qui se sépare de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et fait monter ses idoles immondes dans son cœur, qui place devant sa face la pierre d’achoppement de son iniquité, et qui vient vers le prophète pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consulter par lui, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je lui répondrai par {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}.
fr.B: Car si quelqu’un de la maison d’Israël, ou des étrangers qui vivent en Israël, se sépare de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, installe des idoles dans son cœur, place devant lui l’obstacle qui le fait tomber dans la faute, puis vient trouver un prophète pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consulter par lui, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je lui répondrai {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}.
fr.R: Supposons que quelqu’un d’Israël, ou un étranger qui vit en Israël, se détourne de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Il met les idoles au centre de sa vie et place juste devant lui ce qui le fait tomber dans le péché. Puis il vient trouver un prophète pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} demander conseil. Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je lui répondrai {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}.

ko.L: 이스라엘 집의 누구든지, 또는 이스라엘에 머물러 사는 나그네들 가운데 누구든지, 나를 따르지 않고 떠나서 자기의 더러운 우상들을 마음에 들여놓고 자기 죄악의 걸림돌을 자기 얼굴 앞에 두고서, 예언자를 통하여 나에게 물으려고 그에게 오면, 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 친히 그에게 대답하겠다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 집 사람이든 이스라엘에 사는 나그네든, 누구든지 나를 떠나 마음에 우상들을 세우고 자기를 죄에 빠뜨리는 걸림돌을 얼굴 앞에 두고서, 예언자를 통하여 나에게 물으려고 그를 찾아오면, 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 친히 그에게 대답하겠다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 사람이나 이스라엘에 사는 나그네가 나를 떠났다고 하자. 그 사람이 우상을 삶의 중심으로 삼고, 자기를 죄에 빠지게 하는 것을 바로 눈앞에 두었다. 그러고서 예언자를 찾아가 그를 통하여 나에게 뜻을 묻는다면, 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그에게 직접 대답하겠다.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila mtu wa nyumba ya Israeli, au wa wageni wanaokaa ugenini katika Israeli, anayejitenga asinifuate, na kuzipandisha sanamu zake chafu moyoni mwake na kuweka kikwazo cha uovu wake mbele ya uso wake, kisha akamwendea nabii ili kuniuliza kupitia yeye, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitamjibu kwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana mtu yeyote wa nyumba ya Israeli, au wa wageni wanaoishi katika Israeli, akijitenga {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}, akaweka sanamu moyoni mwake, akaweka kikwazo cha hatia yake mbele ya uso wake, kisha akamwendea nabii ili kuniuliza kupitia yeye, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitamjibu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.
sw.R: Tuseme mtu wa Israeli, au mgeni anayeishi katika Israeli, ananiacha. Anazifanya sanamu kuwa kitu muhimu kuliko vyote maishani mwake na kuweka mbele yake kitu kinachomwangusha katika dhambi. Kisha anamwendea nabii ili aniulize ushauri. Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitamjibu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.

es.L: Porque {{gender:cualquier persona|cualquier hombre}} de la casa de Israel, o de los extranjeros que residen en Israel, que se aparte de ir en pos de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y haga subir sus ídolos inmundos a su corazón, y ponga el tropiezo de su iniquidad delante de su rostro, y venga al profeta para consultarme por medio de él, yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, le responderé por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} mismo.
es.B: Porque si {{gender:alguien|algún hombre}} de la casa de Israel, o de los extranjeros que viven en Israel, se aparta de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, instala ídolos en su corazón, pone delante de su rostro el tropiezo de su culpa y luego acude a un profeta para consultarme por medio de él, yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, le responderé personalmente.
es.R: Supongamos que alguien de Israel, o un extranjero que vive en Israel, se aleja de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Hace de los ídolos el centro de su vida y pone justo delante de sí lo que lo hace caer en pecado. Luego acude a un profeta para pedirme consejo. Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, le responderé personalmente.

vi.L: Vì bất cứ ai trong nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, hoặc trong những ngoại kiều đang kiều ngụ trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, tự tách mình khỏi việc theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đem các thần tượng nhơ bẩn của mình lên trong lòng, đặt vật gây vấp ngã của tội ác mình trước mặt mình, rồi đến với nhà tiên tri để nhờ nhà tiên tri cầu hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sẽ tự mình trả lời người ấy.
vi.B: Vì nếu bất cứ ai trong nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, hoặc trong những ngoại kiều sống trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, tách mình khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, lập thần tượng trong lòng, đặt vật gây vấp ngã dẫn vào tội lỗi trước mặt mình, rồi đến với một nhà tiên tri để nhờ người cầu hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sẽ đích thân trả lời kẻ ấy.
vi.R: Giả sử có người Y-sơ-ra-ên, hay ngoại kiều sống trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Họ đặt thần tượng làm trung tâm đời sống mình, và đặt ngay trước mặt mình thứ làm cho mình sa vào tội lỗi. Rồi họ đến với một nhà tiên tri để hỏi ý {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sẽ trả lời họ.

decisions.choice: the sojourner who sojourns in Israel: the foreigner living among the people, under the same law
decisions.reason: Foreigners who settled in Israel were covered by many of the same laws, including those against idols and those of 14:8 (Leviticus 17:8, 10; 20:2). The wording of these verses follows the style of those laws.

decisions.choice: to inquire of me through him: to seek an oracle from the LORD through the prophet
decisions.reason: The person goes to the prophet to "inquire of the LORD", the usual phrase for asking God for guidance (1 Kings 22:5, 8). The LORD will not answer through the prophet but directly (14:4).

decisions.choice: {{gender:anyone|any man}}; {{gender:themselves|himself}}; {{gender:their|his}}; {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: As in 14:4. "The prophet" keeps "him": the prophets in view are men.

decisions.choice: os imigrantes (L); os estrangeiros (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Old Testament terms give "o estrangeiro, o imigrante" for the foreigner who settles in Israel (m1). Literal says "imigrantes que moram", which keeps the Hebrew's repeated root; Balanced and Readable say "estrangeiros", as the English says "outsiders", "stranger".

decisions.choice: "나그네" for the sojourner (ger)
decisions.reason: The word of the published Leviticus 17:8 for a foreigner living among Israel under the same law.

decisions.choice: "los extranjeros que residen en Israel" (L); "que viven en Israel" (B); "un extranjero que vive en Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: The ger is the foreigner living among the people, as the Jeremiah drafts word it ("el extranjero").

decisions.choice: "ngoại kiều" at every level
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch's word for the ger (Leviticus 16:29), since Ezekiel means the foreigner living under the same law.

decisions.choice: ’les immigrés qui séjournent’ (L); ’les étrangers qui vivent’ (B); ’un étranger qui vit’ (R)
decisions.reason: As the French Leviticus and Numbers word the ger, the foreigner living among the people.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֨י פָנַ֜י בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֗וּא וַהֲשִֽׂמֹתִ֨יהוּ֙ לְא֣וֹת וְלִמְשָׁלִ֔ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֖יו מִתּ֣וֹךְ עַמִּ֑י וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will set my face against the man that and make him a sign and bywords, and I will cut him off from [the] midst of my people; and you will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And I will set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face against that {{gender:person|man}} and make {{gender:them|him}} a sign and a byword, and I will cut {{gender:them|him}} off from the midst of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people; and you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face against that {{gender:person|man}} and make {{gender:them|him}} a sign and a byword. I will cut {{gender:them|him}} off from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will turn against that person. I will make them a warning to others, someone people talk about as an example. I will remove them from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: E porei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rosto contra {{gender:essa pessoa|esse homem}} e {{gender:a|o}} farei sinal e provérbio, e {{gender:a|o}} eliminarei do meio do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo; e vocês saberão que eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Porei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rosto contra {{gender:essa pessoa|esse homem}} e {{gender:a|o}} farei um sinal e um provérbio. Eu {{gender:a|o}} eliminarei do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Vou me voltar contra essa pessoa. Vou fazer dela um aviso para os outros, um exemplo de que todos vão falar. Vou tirá-la do meio do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

fr.L: Et je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face contre celui-là, j’en ferai un signe et des proverbes, et je le retrancherai du milieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ; et vous saurez que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tournerai contre celui-là et j’en ferai un signe et un objet de proverbes. Je le retrancherai de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dresserai contre lui. J’en ferai un exemple qui servira d’avertissement aux autres, quelqu’un dont on parle. Je le retirerai du milieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그 사람에게 내 얼굴을 향하여 [대적하고], 그를 표징과 속담거리로 만들며, 내 백성 가운데서 그를 끊어 버리겠다. 그리고 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그 사람을 대적하여 그를 본보기와 웃음거리로 만들고, 내 백성 가운데서 끊어 버리겠다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 그 사람에게 등을 돌리겠다. 내가 그를 다른 사람들에게 경고가 되게 하고, 사람들이 본보기로 입에 올리는 사람이 되게 하겠다. 내가 그를 내 백성 가운데서 없애 버리겠다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

sw.L: Nami nitaukaza uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi ya mtu huyo, na kumfanya kuwa ishara na methali, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamkatilia mbali kutoka katikati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitaukaza uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi ya mtu huyo na kumfanya kuwa ishara na methali. Nitamkatilia mbali na watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitakuwa adui wa mtu huyo. Nitamfanya kuwa onyo kwa wengine, mtu ambaye watu wanamtaja kama mfano. Nitamwondoa kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro contra {{gender:esa persona|ese hombre}}, y {{gender:la|lo}} pondré por señal y por refrán, y {{gender:la|lo}} cortaré de en medio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo; y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Yo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pondré en contra de {{gender:esa persona|ese hombre}} y {{gender:la|lo}} convertiré en señal y en refrán. {{gender:La|Lo}} eliminaré de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Me volveré contra esa persona. La convertiré en una advertencia para los demás, en un ejemplo del que la gente hable. La quitaré de en medio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Ta sẽ xây mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng người ấy, làm cho người ấy thành một dấu hiệu và một câu tục ngữ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt trừ người ấy khỏi giữa dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; và các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ta sẽ quay mặt nghịch cùng người ấy, làm cho người ấy thành dấu hiệu và câu tục ngữ. Ta sẽ diệt trừ người ấy khỏi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Ta sẽ chống lại người ấy. Ta sẽ làm cho người ấy thành lời cảnh báo cho người khác, một gương xấu ai cũng nhắc đến. Ta sẽ loại trừ người ấy khỏi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

decisions.choice: I will set my face against him and cut him off: the words of the law against idolatry
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks as in Leviticus 17:10 and 20:3, 5-6, where he sets his face against the one who sins and cuts him off from his people. A "byword" is a name people use as a warning or insult (Deuteronomy 28:37).

decisions.choice: make him a sign: the verb form is unusual
alternatives: make him desolate, an object of horror
decisions.reason: The vowels of the verb point to a word meaning "make desolate" or "appall", but the letters fit "set" or "make". Either way the person becomes a public warning.

decisions.choice: you will know that I am the LORD (see 6:7)
decisions.reason: See 6:7.

decisions.choice: {{gender:person|man}}; {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: As in 14:4. Readable says "that person ... them", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: {{gender:essa pessoa|esse homem}}; {{gender:a|o}}
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1); the object pronoun agrees with the noun, so it takes the same setting. Readable says "essa pessoa", which needs none, as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "pondré mi rostro contra" (L); "me pondré en contra de" (B); "me volveré contra" (R)
decisions.reason: God's "I will set my face against", as the terms note sets it for Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: ’je tournerai ma face contre’ (L); ’je me tournerai contre’ (B); ’je me dresserai contre’ (R), for the whole book
decisions.reason: The book’s term list for God’s ’I will set my face against’.

decisions.choice: ’celui-là’, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts the setting on ’that person|man’ and the pronouns after it; French ’celui-là’ is generic and the ’le’ that follows needs no span (see 13:22).

decisions.choice: "nitaukaza uso wangu dhidi ya" (L, B); "nitakuwa adui wa" (R)
decisions.reason: When God sets his face against someone, Literal and Balanced keep the idiom, and Readable gives its sense, "I will be the enemy of"; this is the settled Swahili for Ezekiel.

source.text: וְהַנָּבִ֤יא כִֽי־יְפֻתֶּה֙ וְדִבֶּ֣ר דָּבָ֔ר אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ פִּתֵּ֔יתִי אֵ֖ת הַנָּבִ֣יא הַה֑וּא וְנָטִ֤יתִי אֶת־יָדִי֙ עָלָ֔יו וְהִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔יו מִתּ֖וֹךְ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And the prophet, if he is deceived and speaks a word, I Yahweh have deceived the prophet that, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from [the] midst of my people Israel.

en.L: And the prophet, if he is enticed and speaks a word, I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have enticed that prophet; and I will stretch {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand out on him and destroy him out of the midst of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.
en.B: And if the prophet is deceived and speaks a message, it is I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who have deceived that prophet. I will raise {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against him and wipe him out from among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.
en.R: If a prophet is fooled into giving such people a message, it is I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who have fooled that prophet. I will use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power against him and destroy him from among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.

pt.L: E o profeta, se for seduzido e falar uma palavra, eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, seduzi esse profeta; e estenderei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra ele e o destruirei do meio do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel.
pt.B: E, se o profeta for enganado e der uma mensagem, sou eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, quem enganou esse profeta. Levantarei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra ele e o eliminarei do meio do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel.
pt.R: Se um profeta se deixar enganar e der uma mensagem a essas pessoas, sou eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, quem enganou esse profeta. Vou usar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} poder contra ele e destruí-lo do meio do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel.

fr.L: Et le prophète, s’il se laisse séduire et dit une parole, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui ai séduit ce prophète ; et j’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main sur lui et je le détruirai du milieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.
fr.B: Et si le prophète se laisse tromper et prononce un message, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui ai trompé ce prophète. Je lèverai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre lui et je le ferai disparaître du milieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.
fr.R: Si un prophète se laisse tromper et donne un message à ces gens, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui ai trompé ce prophète. Je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance contre lui et je le ferai disparaître du milieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.

ko.L: 그리고 예언자가 속아서 말을 하면, 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그 예언자를 속인 것이다. 내가 그 위에 내 손을 뻗어 그를 내 백성 이스라엘 가운데서 멸하겠다.
ko.B: 예언자가 속아서 어떤 말을 전한다면, 그 예언자를 속인 이는 바로 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다. 내가 손을 들어 그를 치고, 내 백성 이스라엘 가운데서 없애 버리겠다.
ko.R: 어떤 예언자가 속아서 그런 사람들에게 말을 전해 준다면, 그 예언자를 속인 이는 바로 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다. 내가 내 능력으로 그를 쳐서 내 백성 이스라엘 가운데서 없애 버리겠다.

sw.L: Na nabii, akishawishiwa na kusema neno, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimemshawishi nabii huyo; {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yake na kumwangamiza kutoka katikati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.
sw.B: Na kama nabii akidanganywa na kusema ujumbe, ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, niliyemdanganya nabii huyo. Nitainua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yake na kumwangamiza kutoka kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.
sw.R: Kama nabii akidanganywa hata akawapa watu hao ujumbe, ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, niliyemdanganya nabii huyo. Nitatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} dhidi yake na kumwangamiza kutoka kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.

es.L: Y el profeta, si es engañado y habla una palabra, yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he engañado a ese profeta; y extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra él y lo destruiré de en medio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.
es.B: Y si el profeta se deja engañar y da un mensaje, soy yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, quien ha engañado a ese profeta. Levantaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra él y lo eliminaré de en medio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.
es.R: Si un profeta se deja engañar y les da un mensaje a esas personas, soy yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, quien ha engañado a ese profeta. Usaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder contra él y lo destruiré de en medio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.

vi.L: Còn nhà tiên tri, nếu nó bị dụ dỗ mà nói ra một lời, thì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã dụ dỗ nhà tiên tri ấy; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra trên nó, và hủy diệt nó khỏi giữa dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Còn nếu nhà tiên tri bị lừa mà nói ra một sứ điệp, thì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã lừa nhà tiên tri ấy. Ta sẽ giơ tay ra chống lại nó và diệt trừ nó khỏi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Nếu một nhà tiên tri bị lừa mà nói sứ điệp cho những người ấy, thì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã lừa nhà tiên tri ấy. Ta sẽ dùng quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại nó và tiêu diệt nó khỏi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: "I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet": the LORD gives a false prophet over to his own deception as judgment
alternatives: the LORD permits the deception but does not cause it
decisions.reason: The words are bold. The prophet who agrees to give an oracle to someone who clings to idols is himself caught in the lie he wanted to tell, and the LORD says that this too is his doing. The same thought appears in 1 Kings 22:19-23, where the LORD sends a lying spirit to the prophets of Ahab, and in 2 Thessalonians 2:11. The verse does not say that the LORD leads innocent people into sin: the deception falls on those who have already turned from him, and both are punished (14:10).

decisions.choice: deceived: enticed, persuaded into what is false
decisions.reason: The verb means to persuade or entice, often into something foolish (Jeremiah 20:7; 1 Kings 22:20-22).

decisions.choice: giving such people a message
decisions.reason: Readable says that the case is the one of 14:4 and 14:7: a prophet who answers people who cling to idols.

decisions.choice: "engañar" at every level
decisions.reason: Pathah is to entice or persuade into what is false; "engañar" says this plainly without the sexual sense "seducir" can carry.

decisions.choice: "dụ dỗ" (L); "lừa" (B, R), in the active for the LORD at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the LORD himself enticed the prophet; no level softens it into a passive, and the footnoted meaning decision explains it. The false prophet is "nó", as one judged.

source.text: וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָ֑ם כַּֽעֲוֺן֙ הַדֹּרֵ֔שׁ כַּעֲוֺ֥ן הַנָּבִ֖יא יִֽהְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will bear their iniquity; like [the] iniquity of the inquirer, like [the] iniquity of the prophet it will be,

en.L: And they will bear their iniquity; as the iniquity of the inquirer, so the iniquity of the prophet will be,
en.B: Both will bear their guilt; the guilt of the prophet will be the same as the guilt of the one who consulted him,
en.R: Both the prophet and the person who came to him will be punished for their sin. The prophet's punishment will be the same as theirs.

pt.L: E eles levarão a sua iniquidade; como a iniquidade do que consulta, assim será a iniquidade do profeta,
pt.B: Os dois levarão a sua culpa: a culpa do profeta será igual à culpa de quem o consultou,
pt.R: Tanto o profeta como a pessoa que foi falar com ele vão ser castigados pelo seu pecado. O castigo do profeta vai ser igual ao dela.

fr.L: Et ils porteront leur iniquité ; comme l’iniquité de celui qui consulte, ainsi sera l’iniquité du prophète,
fr.B: L’un et l’autre porteront leur faute : la faute du prophète sera la même que celle de celui qui l’a consulté,
fr.R: Le prophète et celui qui est venu le consulter seront punis tous les deux pour leur péché. Le prophète recevra la même punition qu’eux.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 자기들의 죄악을 짊어질 것이다. 묻는 자의 죄악과 같이 예언자의 죄악도 그러할 것이니,
ko.B: 둘 다 자기 죄의 값을 치를 것이다. 예언자의 죄는 그에게 물으러 온 사람의 죄와 똑같을 것이다.
ko.R: 예언자도, 그에게 찾아온 사람도 모두 자기 죄 때문에 벌을 받을 것이다. 예언자가 받는 벌은 찾아온 사람이 받는 벌과 같을 것이다.

sw.L: Nao watachukua uovu wao; kama uovu wa yule anayeuliza, ndivyo utakavyokuwa uovu wa nabii,
sw.B: Wote wawili watachukua hatia yao; hatia ya nabii itakuwa sawa na hatia ya yule aliyemwuliza,
sw.R: Nabii pamoja na mtu aliyemwendea wataadhibiwa kwa dhambi yao. Adhabu ya nabii itakuwa sawa na adhabu yao.

es.L: Y llevarán su iniquidad; como la iniquidad del que consulta, así será la iniquidad del profeta,
es.B: Ambos cargarán con su culpa; la culpa del profeta será igual que la del que lo consultó,
es.R: Tanto el profeta como la persona que acudió a él serán castigados por su pecado. El castigo del profeta será igual al de esa persona.

vi.L: Chúng sẽ mang lấy tội ác mình; tội ác của kẻ cầu hỏi thế nào, thì tội ác của nhà tiên tri cũng sẽ thế ấy,
vi.B: Cả hai sẽ mang tội mình; tội của nhà tiên tri cũng như tội của kẻ đến cầu hỏi,
vi.R: Cả nhà tiên tri lẫn người đến hỏi đều sẽ bị phạt vì tội của mình. Hình phạt của nhà tiên tri sẽ giống như hình phạt của họ.

decisions.choice: iniquity: guilt and its punishment
decisions.reason: To "bear iniquity" is to carry the consequences of one's guilt, as in the law (Leviticus 5:1; Numbers 14:34). The one who seeks a false word and the one who gives it are punished alike.

decisions.choice: will be punished for their sin
decisions.reason: Readable says what "bearing iniquity" means (m1).

source.text: לְ֠מַעַן לֹֽא־יִתְע֨וּ ע֤וֹד בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאַֽחֲרַ֔י וְלֹֽא־יִטַּמְּא֥וּ ע֖וֹד בְּכָל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֣י לְעָ֗ם וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: so that not they stray again, [the] house of Israel, from after me, and not they defile themselves again with all their transgressions; and they will be to me a people, and I will be to them God, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: so that the house of Israel may no longer go astray from following {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, nor defile themselves anymore with all their transgressions; but they will be to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a people, and I will be to them God, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: so that the house of Israel will no longer stray from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} or defile themselves with all their rebellions. They will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own people, and I will be their God, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then the people of Israel will not wander away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} anymore or make themselves unclean with all their sins. They will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, and I will be their God, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: para que a casa de Israel não se desvie mais de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, nem se contamine mais com todas as suas transgressões; mas eles serão para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} um povo, e eu serei para eles Deus, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.B: para que a casa de Israel não se afaste mais de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} nem se contamine com todas as suas rebeldias. Eles serão o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, e eu serei o Deus deles, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.R: Então o povo de Israel não vai mais se afastar de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, nem vai se tornar impuro com todos os seus pecados. Eles vão ser o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, e eu vou ser o Deus deles, diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.

fr.L: afin que la maison d’Israël ne s’égare plus loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et qu’ils ne se rendent plus impurs par toutes leurs transgressions ; mais ils seront pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un peuple, et je serai pour eux Dieu, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: afin que la maison d’Israël ne s’égare plus loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et ne se rende plus impure par toutes ses rébellions. Ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et je serai leur Dieu, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors le peuple d’Israël ne s’éloignera plus de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et ne se rendra plus impur par tous ses péchés. Ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et je serai leur Dieu, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 이것은 이스라엘 집이 다시는 나를 따르지 않고 길을 잃거나, 자기들의 모든 반역으로 다시는 자신을 더럽히지 않게 하려는 것이다. 그들은 내 백성이 되고, 나는 그들의 하나님이 될 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 이것은 이스라엘 집이 다시는 나를 떠나 헤매지 않고, 자기들의 온갖 반역으로 자신을 더럽히지 않게 하려는 것이다. 그들은 내 백성이 되고, 나는 그들의 하나님이 될 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 그러면 이스라엘 백성이 다시는 나를 떠나 헤매지 않고, 온갖 죄로 자신을 더럽히지 않을 것이다. 그들은 내 백성이 되고, 나는 그들의 하나님이 될 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

sw.L: ili nyumba ya Israeli wasipotee tena wasinifuate, wala wasijitie unajisi tena kwa maasi yao yote; bali watakuwa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} watu, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuwa kwao Mungu, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: ili nyumba ya Israeli wasipotee tena wakaniacha, wala wasijitie unajisi kwa makosa yao yote. Watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuwa Mungu wao, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ndipo watu wa Israeli hawatapotea tena wakaniacha, wala hawatajitia unajisi kwa dhambi zao zote. Watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuwa Mungu wao, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

es.L: para que la casa de Israel no se desvíe más de en pos de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, ni se contamine más con todas sus transgresiones; sino que serán para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} un pueblo, y yo seré para ellos Dios, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: para que la casa de Israel ya no se aleje de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} ni se contamine con todos sus delitos. Ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, y yo seré su Dios, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces el pueblo de Israel ya no se alejará de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} ni se hará impuro con todos sus pecados. Ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, y yo seré su Dios, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: để nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên không còn lầm lạc xa cách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa, cũng không còn làm ô uế mình bằng mọi sự vi phạm của mình nữa; nhưng họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: để nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên không còn lìa xa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cũng không còn làm ô uế mình bằng mọi sự phản nghịch của mình nữa. Họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Rồi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ không còn đi lạc xa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hay làm cho mình ra ô uế bởi mọi tội lỗi của mình nữa. Họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

decisions.choice: they will be my people and I will be their God: the covenant promise, as 11:20
decisions.reason: The aim of the judgment is not destruction but the restored covenant (see 11:20).

decisions.choice: transgressions (L); rebellions (B); sins (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this word: "transgression" at Literal, "crime" or "rebellion" at Balanced, "sin" at Readable.

decisions.choice: transgressões (L); rebeldias (B); pecados (R)
decisions.reason: As the English settles the word (r-en-1) and the Old Testament terms give it: "transgressão" at Literal, "rebeldia" at Balanced, "pecado" at Readable.

decisions.choice: ’transgressions’ (L); ’rébellions’ (B); ’péchés’ (R) for pesha, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The prophets’ term list, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: ’ils seront mon peuple, et je serai leur Dieu’
decisions.reason: The covenant promise in the words of Jeremiah 31:33 and 2 Corinthians 6:16, so the reader hears the same formula.

decisions.choice: "반역" (L, B), "죄" (R) for pesha'
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording.

decisions.choice: "그들은 내 백성이 되고, 나는 그들의 하나님이 될 것이다" for the covenant promise
decisions.reason: The covenant formula as the term sheet gives it for 37:27 and 2 Corinthians 6:16, in the order the Hebrew has here.

decisions.choice: "maasi" (L); "makosa" (B); "dhambi" (R) for pesha'

en.L: Son of man, a land, when it sins against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} by acting faithlessly, and I stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against it and break its staff of bread and send famine upon it and cut off from it human and beast,
en.B: Son of man, suppose a land sins against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} by being unfaithful, and I stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against it, break its supply of bread, send famine on it and cut off from it both people and animals,
en.R: Son of man, suppose the people of a country sin against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} by being unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. So I use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power against that country. I cut off its food supply and send a famine, and both people and animals die.

pt.R: Filho do homem, imagina que o povo de um país peque contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e seja infiel a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Então eu uso o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} poder contra esse país. Corto a comida deles e mando uma fome, e morrem pessoas e animais.

decisions.choice: a land, when it sins: a test case stated like a law
decisions.reason: The oracle sets out a general case in the style of the laws of Leviticus, then applies it to Jerusalem (14:21). The same pattern is repeated four times: famine (14:13-14), wild beasts (14:15-16), sword (14:17-18) and pestilence (14:19-20).

decisions.choice: acting faithlessly: breaking trust with God
decisions.reason: The word means a breach of faith, taking what belongs to God or betraying him (Leviticus 26:40; 2 Chronicles 36:14).

decisions.choice: break the staff of bread: cut off the food supply
decisions.reason: Bread was the "staff" that supported life. The expression comes from Leviticus 26:26 and is used in 4:16 and 5:16.

decisions.choice: supply of bread (B), food supply (R); people and animals (B, R)
alternatives: staff of bread; man and beast
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "staff of bread" and "human and beast". Balanced and Readable give the sense, as Leviticus 26:26 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: L ’l’être humain et la bête’ (alternative ’l’homme et la bête’) for adam and behemah
decisions.reason: Where the English Literal says ’human and beast’, French has to choose a noun for adam; the inclusive ’être humain’ is the default and the traditional ’homme’ the alternative. Balanced and Readable say ’les gens’, which needs no span.

decisions.choice: Daniel: perhaps Danel, a righteous man of ancient times, rather than the Daniel of the book of Daniel
alternatives: Daniel, the Jewish exile at the Babylonian court (Daniel 1-6)
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew spells the name Dan'el, without the letter found in the name of the book's Daniel; the scribes read it as Daniel. Noah and Job were righteous men of the distant past, and neither was an Israelite. Texts from ancient Ugarit, older than Ezekiel by many centuries, tell of Danel, a wise and just king who judged the cause of the widow and the orphan, and Ezekiel names a Danel again as a byword for wisdom in 28:3. Many think this ancient figure is meant. Others think of Daniel of the book of Daniel, a younger contemporary of Ezekiel in Babylon, known for his righteousness and wisdom. The name is written "Daniel", as the scribes read it.

decisions.choice: they would deliver only their own lives: righteousness cannot be passed on to others
decisions.reason: Noah's righteousness saved his family (Genesis 6:9; 7:1), and Job prayed for his sons and his friends (Job 1:5; 42:8). Here even such people would save no one but themselves; 14:16, 18 and 20 add that they could not save even their children. Chapter 18 makes each person answerable for their own life.

decisions.choice: their own lives: themselves
decisions.reason: The word often translated "soul" here means life, the living self.

decisions.choice: the right way they lived
decisions.reason: Readable says what "righteousness" means here: a life lived rightly before God.

decisions.choice: Noé, Daniel e Jó
decisions.reason: The names in their usual Portuguese form, as the Old Testament terms give "Noé". The written Hebrew spells the second name "Danel" (m1); Portuguese follows the scribes' reading and the English, and the meaning note keeps the question.

decisions.reason: The Hebrew spelling here is Danel (m1, footnoted); French keeps the published name of 14:14 and 14:20, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "노아", "다니엘", "욥"
